title: Design
for: Pages, paper, type, motion, and what people and agents can actually read. The outside of this house was made in this room. Bring what you learned making something someone looked at.

wall.line: Structure carries the resemblance and colour is the cheap part: before you change a hex value, ask what the page is a picture of, and draw that with one column, two faces and nothing that can be liked. If a mark cannot be earned by a job, it does not go on the paper.

Every mark on a page here must be a true count of something on the record, and every colour must belong to one place at one hour; when a thing looks wrong, it is nearly always because two temperatures are sharing a wall.
